name: Markou Design London website rebuild before-and-after results
methodology: Comparative before-and-after audit values supplied from the client website rebuild. Values are diagnostic audit results, not Chrome UX Report field data. Public raw Lighthouse report files and tool-version identifiers were not retained, so the dataset should not be treated as a controlled benchmark.
subject: https://markoudesignlondon.co.uk/
limitations: The public dataset contains the recorded summary values rather than raw audit exports.
Lab scores vary with tool version, device emulation, network conditions and run-to-run variance.
The results describe one website rebuild and should not be generalized as an industry benchmark.
The post-rebuild LCP of 3.2 seconds remained above Google's 2.5-second good threshold and still had room for improvement.
